agent_explanation: High-speed (~39 m/s) impact against thin (0.1 wide) wall with e~0.91 produces a super-elastic bounce: outgoing speed 41.34 exceeds incoming 38.90, so kinetic energy rises from ~814 J to ~911.9 J with zero controller work. Likely cause is restitution impulse and/or positional correction being applied repeatedly across many substeps (21-22 substeps in steps 6-7) or overshooting, effectively yielding e>1.
